policy: Every real Roblox asset id in a committable file (rbxassetid://, rbxthumb://, roblox.com asset/place/bundle/badge/pass URLs, numeric AssetId/MeshId/TextureId/SoundId/AnimationId/ImageId/DecalId fields) must have an entry here; 0 is the only placeholder. Only entries with approval 'approved' (reviewer and script_review filled in by the roblox-asset-intake skill) may appear in place content (.luau, .lua, .rbxmx, .rbxlx, .project.json, .model.json, .meta.json). 'research_citation' ids may only be cited in docs and records; 'rejected' ids stay listed so the decision is not redone. Checked by the gate step asset-provenance in tools/check.py. Ids of private assets on the owner's account (such as the round-trip meshes) are never committed.

fields.kind: model, mesh, image, audio, animation, plugin, place, bundle, badge or pass
fields.name: display name at the source
fields.source: URL where the asset was found
fields.creator: publisher at the source
fields.license: licence or terms as read at the source; 'not inspected' when unknown
fields.script_review: script and security review findings (required for approved)
fields.purpose: why the id is in the repo and where it is cited
fields.origin: intake (reviewed in this repo) or inherited_unverified (copied in, never reviewed here)
fields.source_key: optional: the assets/sources.json key the uploaded file came from (its pinned file is in files with the same source_key)

files_policy: files lists external files pinned by python3 tools/fetch_assets.py --pin (the owner's per-item approval). The files themselves live in build/asset-cache/ and are never committed; an entry records where the file came from, its sha256 and bytes, and the licence evidence. Checked by python3 tools/asset_sources.py --check.

files_fields.item: item id within the source (kit/1 cites it as cc0:<source_key>:<item>)
files_fields.url: https URL it was downloaded from, or manual:<page> for a manual download pinned with --from-file
files_fields.type: file type detected from its content
files_fields.licence_text_sha256: sha256 of the legal code text verified at pin time
